subject_session: Mouse32-140820 (deep dive) + 4 more mice for replication

headline_stat.name: HD cells / units in main session

stated_limitation: Because the NWB file carries no epoch annotations, the open-field foraging epoch is identified automatically: long periods where the smoothed head speed exceeds 3 px/s and the trajectory spans the full arena (this rejects movement inside the small rest box).

justification.dataset: 000056 (Peyrache ADn/PoSub) is the canonical head-direction dataset in the correct species, region, and open-field paradigm.
justification.handling: Real streamed data with correct LED-based HD reconstruction and invalid-sample handling, but unit inclusion is only 'has spikes' with no quality filter and epoch detection is reinvented rather than using dataset state annotations.
justification.analysis: MVL tuning with a proper circular time-shift shuffle null, circularly-correct split-half stability, and cross-validated Bayesian decoding against a chance baseline is exactly the right, complete method.
justification.correctness: Reported values reproduce from the print statements, are internally consistent with all figures, and rest on adequate samples and sound controls.
justification.figures: Effect is unmistakable (fig2 spike overlay, fig3 unimodal polar curves, fig6 tightly-peaked decoding error); axes labeled with units and sample sizes, examples ranked by tuning strength itself.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the strong, clean evidence and nothing is misrepresented, but the write-up names no specific limitations of this particular result, holding it at 3.
